name: luxury-triptych-fashion-portrait
image_purpose: fashion lookbook, beauty campaign, editorial composite

prompt.project_info: Create a high-fashion editorial studio portrait presented as a vertical triptych with cinematic luxury aesthetics.
prompt.main_subject: One adult woman with long, sleek chestnut-brown hair, natural realistic skin texture, subtly intensified eyes, and a calm, confident, refined presence. She wears a minimalist black outfit and has original non-celebrity features.
prompt.composition_elements: Single composite image in a vertical triptych with three stacked frames. The top frame is a centered head-and-shoulders portrait with a straight-on symmetrical composition and calm confident expression. The middle frame is an extreme close-up of the eyes in razor-sharp focus, with one hand partially covering the face and long glossy black nails visible. The bottom frame is a three-quarter portrait with one hand posed elegantly near the lips, emphasizing gesture, styling, and poised fashion body language. Use a clean bold graphic layout in portrait orientation with a 1:2 aspect ratio.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic directional studio lighting with soft shadows and sculpted highlights, cinematic high contrast, and a neutral dark studio backdrop. The atmosphere is elegant, powerful, modern, confident, controlled, and luxurious.
prompt.technical_specs: High-fashion editorial studio photography, premium commercial finish, ultra-detailed realistic rendering, sharp eyes in the middle frame, refined natural skin texture, single composite vertical triptych, portrait orientation, 1:2 aspect ratio.
